selection: Scan every complete public step in chronological order with the exact V2 observer-seat belief history and original search's opponent-root native logits, registered rollout index 0 random seed. In each replay retain first four steps where the complete sampled joint opponent command differs between unchanged/new collector logits and at least one opponent collector's issued command differs. Do not select by own policy, own outcome, future command, result, chance of returning an order, or timer. Preserve all opportunities and all selected/failed. Current own action used only to advance prior history after selection. Full opponent commands of the external player never used.
experiment: Run the unchanged V2 and final 8b4 package on precisely these selected observer requests, same source tracker, previous public positions, public configuration, privately controlled RNG derived from sha256(match/step) and fixed parent per-row cost state archived with package/roots.json.gz. Alternate ABBA and BAAB across admitted tickets; no retries for wall time or output. Preserve step 0 if eligible even though native RNG is reinitialized. Record native candidate menu, source actions, sampled opponent orders, CPU/wall, cut status and sorted candidate depth, physical commands. Use the same attributable_changed rule as the 16-root probe, additionally same per-candidate depths within each equal-build repeat. Require both sampled root opponent diagnostics equal their screening orders.
claim: Mechanism on selected roots conditional on enemy forecast being different. Keep unconditional opportunity counts and both opponents. No estimate of overall match strength or deployment qualification.
